cases.body:
Hello,

I am requesting public records for the Arizona 2024 general election that can reconcile electronic election-system output against official results, paper/audit evidence, and custody records. This is an evidence-availability request only; it is not an allegation or proof of tampering.

Requester:
[requester name]
[organization, if any]
[requester email]
[requester phone, optional]

Requested evidence families and tracking IDs:
- EI-2024-AZ-AUDIT-RESULTS - Audit results: status=partial; request status=draft_ready. Official hand-count summaries provide county-level audit context, but detailed audit-unit workpapers and machine-vs-hand count fields are still needed before treating advisory rows as cleared or confirmed. Suggested custodian/path: Use the SOS hand-count document links as source leads, then request detailed county audit workpapers from county election departments or the SOS depending on custody.
- EI-2024-AZ-BALLOT-IMAGES - Ballot images: status=needs_data; request status=draft_ready. Needed to compare voter-mark interpretation against CVR or tabulator interpretation where public or lawfully obtainable. Suggested custodian/path: Use the Arizona SOS NextRequest portal and county election departments to confirm whether ballot images are public or lawfully releasable and who maintains them.
- EI-2024-AZ-CAST-VOTE-RECORDS - Cast vote records: status=needs_data; request status=draft_ready. Needed for independent ballot-level retabulation and comparison to certified totals. Suggested custodian/path: Use the Arizona SOS NextRequest portal for state-maintained records and the SOS county election officials directory for county-maintained CVRs or equivalent ballot-level exports.
- EI-2024-AZ-CHAIN-OF-CUSTODY - Chain of custody: status=needs_data; request status=draft_ready. Needed to explain custody, seal, transport, storage, and removable-media handling around any machine-output anomaly. Suggested custodian/path: Request custody, seal, transport, storage, ballot duplication, adjudication, and removable-media records from county election departments or redirected custodians.
- EI-2024-AZ-LOGIC-ACCURACY - Logic and accuracy records: status=needs_data; request status=draft_ready. Needed to confirm voting systems counted known test ballots as configured before the election. Suggested custodian/path: Request 2024 general-election logic-and-accuracy certificates, test decks, results, and discrepancy/resolution records from county election departments or the SOS if state-maintained.
- EI-2024-AZ-REPORTING-UNIT-RESULTS - Reporting-unit results: status=partial; request status=draft_ready. County-only rows cannot localize machine or batch anomalies. Suggested custodian/path: Request official precinct or local reporting-unit President and U.S. Senate exports from the Arizona Secretary of State or all 15 county election departments, including reporting-unit crosswalks and canvass reconciliation notes.
- EI-2024-AZ-TABULATOR-LOGS - Tabulator and EMS logs: status=needs_data; request status=draft_ready. Needed to review machine events, uploads, adjudication, media handling, and timing anomalies. Suggested custodian/path: Request tabulator, EMS, upload, adjudication, and removable-media logs from the maintaining county election department or redirected custodian.

Preferred production format: original exports where available, CSV, XLSX, JSON, log bundles, audit workpapers, record layouts, or data dictionaries. Please preserve original filenames, timestamps, export settings, and field definitions.

If your office does not maintain a requested record, please identify the state, county, municipal, vendor, or other custodian most likely to maintain it. If fees are expected, please provide an estimate before processing.

Arizona Secretary of State Elections Division
https://azsos.nextrequest.com/
Lookup/redirect reference: https://azsos.gov/elections/about-elections/county-election-officials-contact-information
Use the SOS NextRequest portal for state-maintained records. County election departments may maintain CVRs, ballot images, tabulator logs, L&A materials, custody records, detailed audit artifacts, and subcounty result exports.

Thank you.

I am requesting public records for the Pennsylvania 2024 general election that can reconcile electronic election-system output against official results, paper/audit evidence, and custody records. This is an evidence-availability request only; it is not an allegation or proof of tampering.

Requester:
[requester name]
[organization, if any]
[requester email]
[requester phone, optional]

Requested evidence families and tracking IDs:
- EI-2024-PA-AUDIT-RESULTS - Audit results: status=needs_data; request status=draft_ready. Needed to compare electronic tabulation against paper or audit evidence without treating aggregate audit summaries as per-unit clearance. Suggested custodian/path: Pennsylvania Department of State or county boards; CVR release requires legal/public-records review before treating as obtainable.
- EI-2024-PA-BALLOT-IMAGES - Ballot images: status=needs_data; request status=draft_ready. Needed to compare voter-mark interpretation against CVR or tabulator interpretation where public or lawfully obtainable. Suggested custodian/path: Pennsylvania Department of State or county boards; CVR release requires legal/public-records review before treating as obtainable.
- EI-2024-PA-CAST-VOTE-RECORDS - Cast vote records: status=blocked; request status=draft_ready. CVR retabulation would be useful but should be tracked as constrained until an official lawful source is confirmed. Suggested custodian/path: Pennsylvania Department of State or county boards; CVR release requires legal/public-records review before treating as obtainable.
- EI-2024-PA-CHAIN-OF-CUSTODY - Chain of custody: status=needs_data; request status=draft_ready. Needed to explain custody, seal, transport, storage, and removable-media handling around any machine-output anomaly. Suggested custodian/path: Pennsylvania Department of State or county boards; CVR release requires legal/public-records review before treating as obtainable.
- EI-2024-PA-LOGIC-ACCURACY - Logic and accuracy records: status=needs_data; request status=draft_ready. Needed to confirm voting systems counted known test ballots as configured before the election. Suggested custodian/path: Pennsylvania Department of State or county boards; CVR release requires legal/public-records review before treating as obtainable.
- EI-2024-PA-TABULATOR-LOGS - Tabulator and EMS logs: status=needs_data; request status=draft_ready. Needed to review machine events, uploads, adjudication, media handling, and timing anomalies. Suggested custodian/path: Pennsylvania Department of State or county boards; CVR release requires legal/public-records review before treating as obtainable.

Preferred production format: original exports where available, CSV, XLSX, JSON, log bundles, audit workpapers, record layouts, or data dictionaries. Please preserve original filenames, timestamps, export settings, and field definitions.

If your office does not maintain a requested record, please identify the state, county, municipal, vendor, or other custodian most likely to maintain it. If fees are expected, please provide an estimate before processing.

Routing hint currently recorded for this state:
Pennsylvania Department of State Bureau of Elections
https://www.pa.gov/agencies/vote.html
Lookup/redirect reference: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/vote/contact-us/contact-your-election-officials.html
Pennsylvania counties commonly maintain county-level voting-system records; CVR access may be restricted or require county-specific handling.

Thank you.

Texas SOS open-records routing covers Elections Division records; county election officials or other local election authorities may maintain county-specific CVRs, ballot images, equipment logs, L&A records, custody records, and detailed audit workpapers.

Thank you.
